Question 1

Find an equation of the plane that contains the point P(2,−5,3) and is perpendicular to the vector n=⟨−1,2,−3⟩.

a
r⋅⟨2,−5,3⟩=21
b
r⋅⟨−1,2,−3⟩=⟨−2,5,−3⟩
c
r⋅⟨−1,2,−3⟩=−3
d
r⋅⟨2,−5,3⟩=⟨−1,2,−3⟩
e
r⋅⟨−1,2,−3⟩=−21
